name: BRHT — Fable Fury Shopify inventory live sync — IMPORT READY

parameters.query:
WITH latest_date AS (
  SELECT MAX(date) AS date
  FROM shopify_product_inventory_daily
)
SELECT
  d.product_id::text AS product_id,
  COALESCE(p.product_name, sp.product_name, d.product_id::text) AS product_name,
  d.inventory_count::numeric AS available_quantity,
  d.date::text AS inventory_date,
  d.updated_at
FROM shopify_product_inventory_daily d
JOIN latest_date ld ON ld.date = d.date
LEFT JOIN products p ON p.product_id::text = d.product_id::text
LEFT JOIN shopify_products sp ON sp.product_id::text = d.product_id::text
ORDER BY product_name;
